title: GenerationJob
description: Core -> AI service (POST /jobs): one generation job (B7 R1). The service keeps jobs only in memory; the core owns open jobs. request_id is the job id. Sending the SAME job again (same id, same content) is harmless and returns the existing job, e.g. after a lost answer. A NEW attempt (after a failed job, or after the service restarted and answers not_found) always gets a NEW request_id, like Resend for decisions. Same id with different content is rejected (bad_request, not retryable).

request_id.description: Deterministic id from the core; also the job id. New attempt = new id.

tick.description: Tick at which the core created the job.

priority.description: Higher runs first; ties in order of arrival. Values come from data in the core (B7 O2).

inhabitant.description: Inhabitant the job is about, if any.

object.description: Object the job is about, if any.

JobPayload.description: One field per job kind; exactly the field named like the kind is set, all others are null (checked by the service). Required-and-nullable instead of optional, so both generated type systems round-trip the same JSON (optional fields would be written as null).

QuestionPayload.description: An inhabitant does not understand something and asks (W1595). No deadline (B2487): answered at once on strong PCs, at the latest in the computing night.

question.description: what_is = what is this; can_i_eat; is_dangerous; what_can_i_do = what can I do with it; why = why did this happen.

perception.description: What the inhabitant notices about the subject right now (observable properties only, no truth).
